Name: Winter Solstice Hats
Author: wabiii
Description:
[list]
[*][size=3]Adds a set of winter and Christmas themed hats with some being animated or colourable[/size]
[*][size=3]These can be selected with the [u]hand mirror[/u] from the fashion sense mod, this is bought from Pierres. [img]https://i.imgur.com/dRt6lC5.png[/img]﻿[/size]
[*][b][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion sense[/url][u]﻿[/u] must be installed as this is a pack for the mod[/size][/b]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][b]   To install this mod simply place and extract it into the mods folder
   
   [size=3]To use, right-click the hand mirror and select the hats option and simply pick which one you'd like[/size]

[/b][img]https://i.imgur.com/QYCweHz.png[/img]
[size=2] [/size]
